unnamed-god.label: Unnamed god
unnamed-god.note: The ritual addresses a god without naming one. The image is inspired by carvings of gods at Yazılıkaya.

unnamed-goddess.label: Unnamed goddess
unnamed-goddess.note: The ritual addresses a goddess. The image is inspired by carvings of goddesses at Yazılıkaya.

storm-god.label: Storm-god
storm-god.note: The Storm-god was a powerful weather deity. The image is inspired by a carving of Teššub at Yazılıkaya.

sun-god.label: Sun-god
sun-god.model: Sun-god of Heaven relief at Yazılıkaya, no. 34
sun-god.note: The ritual addresses the sun god. The image is inspired by a carving of the Sun-god of Heaven at Yazılıkaya.

the-seven.label: The Seven
the-seven.model: Repeated male deity reliefs at Yazılıkaya
the-seven.note: The ritual names the Seven, a group of gods also called the Sebettu. The image draws on a group of divine figures at Yazılıkaya.

divine-assembly.label: All the gods
divine-assembly.model: Male and female deity processions at Yazılıkaya
divine-assembly.note: The ritual addresses all the gods together. The image draws on processions of gods and goddesses at Yazılıkaya.
